# Mnemosyne OS

> Mnemosyne OS is a local-first memory engine for AI agents. Memory lives in a
> SQLite file on your own disk, the core imports nothing outside the Python
> standard library, and there is no hosted control plane in the path. MIT
> licensed. Published as `mnemosyne-os` on PyPI.

Current version: **8.0.0** (released 2026-09-22).
Canonical site: https://ai-memory.net/
Source: https://github.com/MnemosyneOS/mnemosyne

## What it is

- **Local-first, zero-cloud.** The store is a SQLite file you own. Deleting the
  file is a complete deletion — there is no replica to chase.
- **Zero third-party dependencies in the core.** `install_requires` is an empty
  list. The vector tier is optional and fails soft to local FTS5 indexing.
- **No telemetry.** Nothing is collected, so there is nothing to opt out of.
- **Tamper-evident.** Every write is chained into a SHA-256 ledger; verification
  names the record that was altered rather than just reporting a mismatch.
- **Compression.** The AIC (Adaptive Information Capsule) layer reports 32x
  lossless compression of stored context.

## Interface surface

- **MCP server — 31 tools**: 20 native tools plus 11 client-compatible tools
  (`add_memory`, `search_memories`, and the rest of the widely-implemented set).
  Transports: stdio and Streamable HTTP.
- **Memory API**: `from mnemosyne import Memory`.
- **REST API**: versions v1, v2 and v3.
- **CLI**: `python mnemosyne.py --help`.
- **Optional integrations — 72**: 20 LLM providers, 13 embedding providers,
  28 vector stores, 5 rerankers, 6 graph stores. All optional; the core runs
  with none of them installed.

## Published measurements

Recall and storage, from the project's own benchmark report:

- Hybrid recall latency: 0.21 ms (p50).
- LongMemEval: **96.2** / 100 (Mem0 reports 94.4).
- LoCoMo: **94.8** / 100 (Mem0 reports 92.5).
- BEAM 1M: **68.5** / 100 (Mem0 reports 64.1).
- BEAM 10M: **53.9** / 100 (Mem0 reports 48.6).

Comparison figures for Mem0 are the ones Mem0 publishes on mem0.ai/research.
Harnesses for reproducing the Mnemosyne numbers ship in the repository under
`scripts/`.

## Install

```
pip install mnemosyne-os
```

The core installs no third-party packages. Provider SDKs are opt-in extras.
